name: LTX-2.3_ cinematic hardcut
description: LTX-2.3 Cinematic Hard Cut LoRA This LoRA is designed to help LTX-2.3 generate more convincing and consistent cinematic hard cut transitions within a single video generation. strength 0.2-1.0 LTX-2.3 is already capable of doing hard cuts on its own, much like Wan , but this LoRA is meant to give it that extra push and improve consistency when you want those shot changes to land more reliably. In some cases, a strength of around 0.2 should be enough but feel free to experiement. This makes it useful for scenes that shift abruptly from one shot to another in a deliberate, film-like way, such as cutting from a wide character action shot to a close-up detail shot, an object of focus, or a dramatic reaction shot. Examples of this style include moments like a character walking toward a tree, followed by a cinematic hard cut to a close-up of an apple hanging from a branch, or a knight crossing a battlefield before the shot suddenly cuts to his hand tightening around a sword hilt. The goal of this LoRA is to reinforce that kind of visual language so your prompts can produce sequences that feel more intentionally edited and cinematic.
